Press

Tienda Salvadoreña in the press

We document the impact of Tienda Salvadoreña on the community: articles, mentions and recognitions that tell our story.

Featured Coverage

  • "Tienda Salvadoreña is a business located in Denver, Colorado, and was the first store with products from El Salvador founded in that city."

    Diario El Salvador · 2023

  • "Most of the people who visit the business are filled with nostalgia when they see the traditional foods they find."

    Diario El Salvador · 2023

  • "People come here from all over Colorado, Wyoming and Nebraska to buy cheeses and souvenirs that he imports from home."

    Denverite · 2018

  • "On East Colfax, next to the trendy Bellwether coffeeshop, Jorge Romero and his wife, Delia, have run a Salvadoran grocery for more than 25 years."

    Denverite · 2018

Featured Articles

  • A store in Denver celebrates 32 years of sharing Salvadoran culture – Diario El Salvador
  • DACA fight overshadows status battle for Denver's Salvadorans – Denverite

Images and Credits

Community Impact

Delia and Jorge have been recognized for their service to the community, especially during emergencies such as earthquakes in El Salvador. The store has served as a cultural meeting point and support for generations of families.

Recognition

  • 1991 First Salvadoran business in Denver (1991)
  • ♥ Community support during humanitarian crises
